title: Aider Local Gateway Configuration (YAML)
description: Three lines of YAML configure Aider to use the local gateway: openai-api-base points to localhost:4000/v1 and openai-api-key uses the placeholder sk-litellm-local.

steps.description: The config adds two keys to ~/.aider.conf.yml: openai-api-base for the gateway URL and openai-api-key for the dummy key.
Line 2 uses the /v1 path suffix for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

steps.question: What is the API key value in the Aider config?
